Training & Education Programs — Robot Operator Training
Hands-on training for frontline staff on robot operation, safety procedures, and basic troubleshooting. 2-day program, no prior technical experience required.
Duration: 2 days

Learn to program our collaborative robotss using teach-by-demonstration, Python scripting, and ROS 2. Covers path planning, vision integration, and task sequencing.
Duration: 5 days

Deep dive into the AI technologies powering our robots. Learn to train custom object detection models and deploy models to edge devices.
Duration: 3 days
